2608.29249.title: Validating FKG.in: Soundness Assessment in LLM-Augmented Indian Food Knowledge
2608.29249.paper_summary: The online culinary ecosystem is increasingly populated by recipe content generated, modified, or summarized by Large Language Models (LLMs). While often plausible, such outputs may contain hallucinated ingredients, misrepresented quantities, or culturally implausible combinations, limiting their suitability for downstream applications and knowledge graph construction. In this paper, we present a semi-automated soundness assessment workflow for validating structured recipe data extracted and augmented by LLMs from informal culinary sources. Developed as part of FKG.in, a knowledge graph of Indian food, the pipeline identifies and addresses common failure modes, including structural inconsistencies, semantic and logical incoherence, and deviations from the source text, through a multi-stage process combining formal grammars, vocabulary-based checks, statistical heuristics, Set Transformer-based coherence modeling, and retrieval-based verification. Although evaluated on Indian recipes, the proposed methods are applicable to broader multilingual and multicultural culinary domains. We provide a practical, auditable, and application-agnostic framework for validating LLM-augmented recipe data, thereby strengthening the foundations of machine-readable food knowledge infrastructures in the era of LLM-generated content.
2608.29249.paper_summary_zh: 在線烹飪生態系統中，越來越多的食譜內容是由大型語言模型（LLMs）生成、修改或總結的。雖然這些輸出通常看起來合理，但可能包含虛構的成分、錯誤的數量或文化上不合理的組合，限制了它們在下游應用和知識圖譜構建中的適用性。在本文中，我們提出了一種半自動的合理性評估工作流程，用於驗證從非正式烹飪來源中提取和增強的結構化食譜數據，這些數據由LLMs生成。該流程作為FKG.in的一部分開發，FKG.in是一個印度食品的知識圖譜，該管道通過結合正式語法、基於詞彙的檢查、統計啟發式方法、基於集合Transformer的連貫性建模和基於檢索的驗證，識別並解決常見的失敗模式，包括結構不一致、語義和邏輯不連貫以及與源文本的偏差。儘管是在印度食譜上進行評估，但所提出的方法適用於更廣泛的多語言和多文化烹飪領域。我們提供了一個實用的、可審計的、與應用無關的框架，用於驗證LLM增強的食譜數據，從而加強了在LLM生成內容時期機器可讀食品知識基礎設施的基礎。
